full_name: Roger Reeves | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2021–2022 Fiction & Poetry Suzanne Young Murray Fellow The University of Texas at Austin
bio: Roger Reeves’s poems have appeared in the American Poetry Review, The Best American Poetry 2014, Boston Review, the New Yorker, Ploughshares, Poetry, and Tin House, among other publications. He is an associate professor of English and creative writing at the University of Texas at Austin.
